description: Blocks a Workflow whose agent() calls carry no agentType — the defect behind two of the three measured fan-outs that ran 100% on the session model, at the session's effort. Notes (never blocks) an Agent call that names no tier and no model, and warns once per session when CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL or CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL_FORCE overrides every tier. Notes reach the model through additionalContext. Fails open on any error; a Workflow call is waived with a `// untiered: <reason>` comment.
